reviews.title: Inaccurate step counter
reviews.text: Horrible accuracy when counting steps.

reviews.title: Update lacking
reviews.text: There appears to be no place in the app or online to control the number of emails that are sent to you. I would like to restrict the number of emails (as I did before) but can’t.

reviews.title: Boooo
reviews.text: Wish my company would go back to another app.   Walkingspree sucks and never works

reviews.title: App Sucks
reviews.text: Fails to sync with Apple Health and login to reset takes 24 hours or more. Help function is worthless.

reviews.title: Used to be better
reviews.text: Before the update, I would get notified where I was throughout the day, not anymore. My steps will not sync unless I do it manually.   I also don’t like that our “program admin” has to place us in our groups. I appreciate the app for the motivation and friendly competition, just not a fan of the update.

reviews.title: Latest update doesn’t work
reviews.text: I just updated the Walkingspree app to it’s latest version and nothing works. It won’t show my daily steps and my record is showing fewer 10k steps than I had. Looks like a lot of information was lost, and the interface is non responsive. Complete mess. I might have to remove the app.

reviews.title: Upgrade to version 11 broke all connections
reviews.text: Horrible update. Step screen is now tiny and hard to see. Don’t Update!

reviews.title: Apple Health sync issue
reviews.text: I had issues with syncing with Apple Health. Even with support team assistance the issue was not resolved.

reviews.title: Forced to use, wish I could delete
reviews.text: Clunky, doesn’t update well, I don’t know why myhealthcheck got roped into using this program but sheesh there’s got to be something better

reviews.title: Walking Spree
reviews.text: Yes, I concur this app is terrible. It doesn’t tell you of your progress. You can’t find anything they hide the reimbursement window in the mobile app and it took forever to find it on the website. Then after I fill out my reimbursement all of a sudden I see every day. The app design is absolutely terrible.

reviews.title: Annoying in so many ways
reviews.text:
I lift and do the stair master in the gym. I spend 2-3 hours on the weekends in the gym but I can’t log my full workouts because “it’s not fair” and there’s no limit on tracking devices. I track my workouts on my Apple Watch and it doesn’t transfer to the app. It’s not fair that I do the work and can’t log it! 
Navigating is also horrible. I can’t bookmark my company so I have to search then I see my progress vs my colleagues there. I can’t see my history so I’m not sure if I have entered all of my workouts. 
So many opportunities for improvement.

reviews.title: do not recommend
reviews.text: app is constantly crashing and disconnecting from apple health. does not sync accurately, my apple watch/apple health will say i have 9k steps and the app will only give me credit for 6K. my employer relies on the app for our fitness stipend so when it didn’t sync correctly i miss out on the stipend.

reviews.title: Clunky, missing challenge data, terrible navigation.
reviews.text: This app is terrible compared to other trackers. You can’t see challenge progress within an event. You click on challenges and it just shows them. You can’t see anything as to the challenge tasks or your progress.  For example; we have a current challenge with 21 days left, but nowhere can I even click on the challenge to find the tasks and progress of myself or anyone else.  I can’t even see who’s in the challenge.  So if you plan to do challenges I would not choose this app.

reviews.title: Missing steps
reviews.text: Everything started really well with this app. I go to the same park and do the same rounds, yet lately the step counts are less than all the other times. It’s very discouraging. Especially when trying to meet challenges.

reviews.title: Suddenly it doesn’t work
reviews.text:
Used to work great, but all of a sudden since yesterday  first i couldn’t log in and now it won’t open. I also tried to get app support but i received a message saying that the page doesn’t exist . 
I’m not sure where i can go to find out how to fix it.

reviews.title: Horrible. App doesn’t load
reviews.text: App doesn’t load and crashes often. I do NOT recommend.

reviews.title: Loving this
reviews.text: I’m really loving this app. I like that it updates me on my number is steps and rewards me for moving. I also love that you can add a friend and start a little competition 👍🏾

reviews.title: Crashes when opening
reviews.text: Crashes when opening on iPhone 12 Mini

reviews.title: Unreliable and terrible sync functionality
reviews.text: Installed it for a company health challenge competition and does not accurately display steps recorded by Apple, rolls back the number of steps few times a day, and has issues updating. If you are in competition you cannot rely on the this app to accurately reflect your place. Absolutely awful and frustrating.

reviews.title: Great but….
reviews.text: Great overall But having a hard time joining friends for competitions, etc.

reviews.title: Difficult to sync with Apple Health
reviews.text: Use WalkingSpree through my employer to receive health insurance discounts. I use an Apple Watch to record steps, etc. the sync function is poor and inconsistent, not tracking all my activity for my health insurance.  Frustrating.

reviews.title: Sugarbaby loves it!
reviews.text: I really enjoy this app! It motivates me to walk a little more each day, and it integrates well with Apple Fitness and the workout app on my watch. Don’t miss out, Y’all - as far as walkin’ is concerned, this one works!

reviews.title: New UI is a downgrade
reviews.text:
App was just okay before the update. Now it’s substantially worse. My coworkers/teams/challenges are now much harder to see where I rank. The challenges page used to have rank available which was very important to me. The new ui just has a map and it’s really challenging to see rank for everyone near you when they’re pucks moving on a jpeg.

I’m not struggling with syncing like many others, but I wish when I opened the app I had more information available rather than having to scroll or change pages to find it.

reviews.title: It does 1 thing. Badly.
reviews.text: It is astoundingly slow to pull steps from Apple Health, if it even manages do it. This is a function countless apps do instantly. Embarrassing.

reviews.title: Bloated
reviews.text: Less is more. Get rid of all unnecessary junk you added.

reviews.title: App Help Screens DO NOT look like the version on App Store
reviews.text: This is very frustrating!  I go to get help and the screens shown are COMPLETELY different than the ones I have in my app.  There’s no way to manually add in steps like it says you can do on the “Help” section of the website.  Please fix this!  Please allow us to manually add in steps when you can’t get your watch to sync.

reviews.title: Enough with the required updates
reviews.text: My employer switched to this app for the steps wellness program.  The app works fine for what it is, but I’m getting sick of opening the app to sync my steps only for the app to lock me out until I compete the update. Can you please just let people use the app and update it on their own time?

reviews.title: Fine before big update
reviews.text: This app was totally fine before this most recent update. Coming from the Fitbit app prior to this, walkingspree was such an improvement from that. It was very user-friendly easy to sync and easy to add activity. This new overhaul is horrible. It is hard to find the spot to enter activity like cycling that doesn’t track properly on tracking devices, it doesnt always update steps/activity immediately after entering such activity (or from yesterday if tou forget to enter same day), and is not at all user friendly anymore. Average monthly steps are buried in a carusel you have to scroll through which is the only reason i use this app. 👎

reviews.title: Years and years of bugs
reviews.text:
This is one of the worst step tracker apps I’ve encountered. My workplace used this app for walking challenges a few years back and I had to bow out after several back and forths w customer service being unable to sync properly to my Fitbit account. It felt like I was dealing with a ragtag handful of developers playing guess and check to troubleshoot. 

Three years later, I decided to give them another shot for another company walking challenge. The latest version is as terrible as the first. So many problems just logging in. After getting past that with the help of support, the app is still awful. Crashes EVERY time I click on Profile. Difficult to navigate. Terrible UI. Even the website doesn’t have a mobile version. Complete amateur hour. In tech, three years with no improvement would normally mean a sudden death. Walkingspree’s only edge here is that it isn’t widely enough used for people to shut it down.

reviews.title: New update is absolutely terrible
reviews.text: UI is awful, steps and activity don’t sync correctly, the calendar view was very useful and is now gone, went from a great app to dismal.

reviews.title: Syncing
reviews.text: I am finding the most recent version difficult to use. When I tap sync steps it won’t sync. And when I can get it to sync steps it only syncs for the current day, any past days wont sync.

reviews.title: Loved it before this last update
reviews.text: I have had nothing but issues with it since this last update. Doesn’t load. Does not have my correct steps documented. Before that I loved it because my sister and I would challenge each other on our daily steps and do the challenges.

reviews.title: New update made UI more difficult
reviews.text: Prior to the latest update, it was easy to log activities that aren’t walking. I can’t find the log activity tab now. This should be intuitive and easy to find

reviews.title: Need to fix the updated app
reviews.text: The old app worked just fine but ever since the update, nothing has loaded on my app or my co workers for the past 2 days. The spot to record exercises (when it shows up) is so hard to find and it’s hard to find the calendar view. Not impressed.

reviews.title: Not working since 10.0.3
reviews.text: All screens are blank, crashes and sync inaccurate or doesn’t happen at all.

reviews.title: Retired
reviews.text: Sign up because I’m retired and haven’t worked and a business for a while. I do have a website writerslink.com but that doesn’t seem to work so how the heck do I sign up?

reviews.title: Walking Spree Review
reviews.text:
Very helpful in keeping me on track with my fitness goals!
It motivates me!

reviews.title: My Motivator!
reviews.text: With Walkingspree, I was encouraged to keep on stepping so as to compete with colleagues and coworkers. It’s a good feeling to do something that is as natural  as walking and be competitive with others. When it comes to the challenges, I am always giving it all I can as to get that gift at the end of the challenge. I love everything Walkingspree. Thank you!

reviews.title: Synching is not great
reviews.text: I like how it looks, but unfortunately the synchronization between the watch, phone and app is not great. Most of the time it doesn’t log accurately. It would be nice if it logged your steps properly and if it encouraged exercising as well as steps.

reviews.title: Disconnect
reviews.text: Keeps disconnecting from the device even though it’s never more than 5 feet away. I get notifications that it’s been 8-10 days since my last recorded activity which would not happen if it remained connected.

reviews.title: Have to manually update
reviews.text: My work uses this app for rewards and I haven’t been getting my full reward because this app does not update before the end of the event. Even though I was told to manually update it. There are lots problems for the simplicity of this app.

reviews.title: Fails to Sync
reviews.text: The app fails to sync with Apple’s own Health app, which properly displays steps.

reviews.title: Mileage
reviews.text:
Please include percentages of a mile.

I want to know if I walked 1.9 miles or 2 miles.

Did I walk 1.4 miles or just 1 mile and no more.

reviews.title: Competition
reviews.text: Great motivation to best your coworkers!

reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text: The one time I had an issue with the app, I wrote them an email with the problem I was having.  Their team contacted me that same day and resolved my issue the following day.  I was very impressed with their level of professionalism and wish others had the same customer service.

reviews.title: Enjoy
reviews.text: Very easy to use

reviews.title: Great App
reviews.text:
I use this app with work. It is easy to use and fun to see the friendly competition between all of my coworkers. 
I like that I can see my ranking anytime and can push a bit harder to stay in the top 20!

reviews.title: Not tracking
reviews.text: This app does not read your Apple Watch but claimed to retrieve data from Apple health. When I use only the phone it still only reads about 85% of the actual steps taken. The cal counter is not impressive due to the lack of fresh foods programmed in it is more suited for packaged processed or big restaurant chain meals. If it wasn’t for my employer rewards program I would probably delete it off my phone.

reviews.title: No automatic synch
reviews.text: If you want your steps to count up, you have to log in everyday to the app, it doesn’t sync automatically

reviews.title: Terrible app, terrible support
reviews.text: Worked ok for about a month then stopped tracking steps because it wasn’t connecting other Apple health as advertised.  Contacted customer support and offered to show data proving the app wasn’t tracking properly and was completely ignored. There are better tracking apps than this it’s not worth the time or hassle.
